job_description:
Job Title: Ethical Hacker

We are looking for an Ethical Hacker to identify and report security vulnerabilities in web applications and networks.

Responsibilities:
- Perform vulnerability assessments.
- Conduct penetration testing.
- Scan networks using Nmap.
- Test web applications using Burp Suite.
- Identify OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
- Write vulnerability reports.
- Recommend security fixes.

Required Skills:
- Linux
- Networking
- Nmap
- Burp Suite
- OWASP Top 10
- SQL Injection
- Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
- Metasploit
- Basic Python
- Git

Experience:
Basic knowledge of cybersecurity and ethical hacking is preferred.
